configurePresets.name: sly2-base
configurePresets.description: DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- these presets cannot be used with `cmake --preset` from this directory: CMake reads presets from the SOURCE directory, and the source directory must be engine/ (this root has no CMakeLists.txt; `cmake --preset sly2-elf` here fails with 'does not appear to contain CMakeLists.txt'). They record the cache variables build.sh / build.ps1 pass: NativeEE (engine/) as the source tree, this repository's games/ as PS2R_GAMES_DIR, the build dir OUTSIDE the repository (it receives the extracted ELF and the recompiled code, game-derived, never committed). Use ./build.sh [--disc|--elf|--no-disc] [--preset <ENGINE preset>] -- it runs `cmake -S engine -B <build dir> --preset <macos-release|linux-release|...>` with these -D values, so the engine's per-platform toolchain comes from engine/CMakePresets.json.

configurePresets.name: sly2-disc
configurePresets.description: Your own disc image: NATIVEEE_DISC from the environment (or -DNATIVEEE_DISC=...). The ELF is extracted and SHA-256 gated at build time.

configurePresets.name: sly2-elf
configurePresets.description: The loose ELF (SCUS_973.16): NATIVEEE_TITLE_ELF from the environment (or -DNATIVEEE_TITLE_ELF=...), hashed at configure time.
